key_point: Kirby is named after the lawyer who won Nintendo's King Kong lawsuit
title: Kirby is named after the lawyer who saved Nintendo.
caption: Kirby is named after the lawyer who saved Nintendo. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #kirby #nintendo #donkeykong

instagram.caption:
Kirby is named after the lawyer who saved Nintendo.

In 1982 Universal sued, saying Donkey Kong copied King Kong. Lawyer John Kirby showed that Universal had once argued in court that King Kong belonged to everyone. Nintendo won.

Nintendo thanked him with a sailboat named Donkey Kong. Ten years later its new pink hero got his name.
